name: Wonder Realms
description: Worlds beyond the everyday. Tiny Worlds: shrink to insect size (and shrink mobs with a Shrink Ray), carve blocks pixel by pixel, trade with the Pixel Miners and ride rhino beetles up walls. Dragons: win eggs from the dragons of the sky islands, raise them, armor them, pack their saddlebags, saddle up and fly, breathing fire, frost, lightning, spores, water, crystal or shadow, and even hatch the End's Dragon Egg. Sky Islands & Airships: eight kinds of floating island with dragon roosts, ruins and pillager sky outposts to conquer, and airships with cannons to build, paint or capture.
